```{r, models}

kn <- quantile(demo_data$weekly_mileage_km, c(.05, .35, .65, .95))
x_range <- range(c(demo_data$weekly_mileage_km, demo_data_test$weekly_mileage_km))

fits <- list(
  raw = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ poly(weekly_mileage_km, 5, raw = TRUE), data = demo_data),

  orthogonal = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ poly(weekly_mileage_km, 5), data = demo_data),

  bernstein = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ bpoly(weekly_mileage_km, 5, Boundary.knots = range(x_range)), data = demo_data),

  linear_sp = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ bs(weekly_mileage_km, degree = 1, knots = kn[2:3]), data = demo_data),

  cubic_sp = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ bs(weekly_mileage_km, knots = kn[2:3]), data = demo_data),

  natural_sp = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ ns(weekly_mileage_km, knots = kn[2:3], Boundary.knots = kn[c(1, 4)]), data = demo_data),

  rcs = lm(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ rcs(weekly_mileage_km, kn), data = demo_data)
)

test_mse <- function(f) {
  mean((demo_data_test$actual_finish_time_minutes - predict(f, demo_data_test))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
}
cond_num <- function(f) kappa(scale(model.matrix(f)[, -1]), exact = TRUE)

data.frame(test_mse = sapply(fits, test_mse),
           condition_number = sapply(fits, cond_num)) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

```


```{r test-data}

mean(demo_data$running_experience_months == 6)    # share of runners at the floor
hist(demo_data$running_experience_months, breaks = 50)

plot(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ running_experience_months, data = demo_data,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3))
lines(lowess(demo_data$running_experience_months, demo_data$actual_finish_time_minutes),
      col = "darkorange", lwd = 3)
```

```{r}
y <- demo_data$actual_finish_time_minutes
num_vars <- setdiff(names(demo_data)[sapply(demo_data, is.numeric)],
                    "actual_finish_time_minutes")

screen <- do.call(rbind, lapply(num_vars, function(v) {
  x  <- demo_data[[v]]
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x  <- x[ok]; yy <- y[ok]

  kn <- unique(quantile(x, c(.05, .35, .65, .95)))
  gain <- if (length(kn) < 3) NA else {
    r2_ns <- summary(lm(yy ~ splines::ns(x, knots = kn[-c(1, length(kn))],
                                         Boundary.knots = range(kn))))$r.squared
    r2_ns - summary(lm(yy ~ x))$r.squared
  }

  data.frame(variable  = v,
             n_unique  = length(unique(x)),
             top_share = round(max(table(x)) / length(x), 3),   # share at the most common value
             r2_gain   = round(gain, 4))
}))

screen[order(-screen$r2_gain), ]
```


```{r}

x <- demo_data$running_experience_months
as.numeric(names(which.max(table(x))))   # the most common value
hist(x, breaks = 50)

# 1. Create the scatterplot
plot(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ running_experience_months, data = demo_data,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3))

# 2. Compute the lowess values
lowess_fit <- stats::lowess(demo_data$running_experience_months,
                            demo_data$actual_finish_time_minutes,
                            f = 0.9, delta = 0)

# 3. Sort by X so the line draws cleanly from left to right
lines(lowess_fit$x[order(lowess_fit$x)], 
      lowess_fit$y[order(lowess_fit$x)], 
      col = "darkorange", lwd = 3)


```

```{r}
# 1. Fit the LOESS model 
# (span = 0.9 matches your f = 0.9; surface = "direct" prevents shortcut approximations)
smooth_model <- loess(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ running_experience_months, 
                      data = demo_data, span = 0.9, surface = "direct")

# 2. Create a clean, evenly spaced grid from your minimum to maximum X values
grid_x <- seq(min(demo_data$running_experience_months, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(demo_data$running_experience_months, na.rm = TRUE), 
              length.out = 300)

# 3. Predict Y values across that clean sequence
grid_y <- predict(smooth_model, newdata = data.frame(running_experience_months = grid_x))

# 4. Plot
plot(actual_finish_time_minutes ~ running_experience_months, data = demo_data,
     pch = 16, col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3))
lines(grid_x, grid_y, col = "darkorange", lwd = 3)


```
